defect.message: The description specifies "Steel plate girders acting compositely with a 0.25 m cast-in-place deck slab ... steel girder depth 1.4 m, top flange 400 mm x 25 mm, bottom flange 500 mm x 30 mm, web 1345 mm x 16 mm, steel Q345". The knowledge graph covers only concrete girder types (small_box, t_girder, cast_box) and concrete girder rules: its section schemas have no steel plate-girder fields, girder.A/girder.I rules (MR-02) assume concrete section integration, and girder.Ec (JTG3362-3.1.5) draws from a concrete grade table. Queries for "steel", "steel plate girder" and "plate" return no matching rules or clauses. A steel plate girder with a composite concrete deck therefore lies outside the scope of the knowledge graph and cannot be modeled with its rules and clauses.
